summary: Iteration 4 full-stack verification. Backend 16/16 pytest cases PASS. Verified: (a) Hierarchical Locations — GET returns parent_id/path/depth for every row, POST supports parent_id and rejects dup-sibling (409), '/' in name (400); PUT rejects dup-sibling (409); DELETE returns 409 when node has children; migration ensures every doc has parent_id. Depth 3+ verified via API (Test-Root / Test-A / Test-1 / Test-x). (b) Shows CRUD — GET sorted, POST 409 on (name+year) dupe, same name different year OK, PUT edits year, DELETE 409 when used as original OR additional. (c) Costume model — creator/original_show_id/additional_show_ids accepted; origin_year auto-populated from original show; PUT show year propagates origin_year to all costumes using it as original (verified). last_year_used is REMOVED from output model. (d) Sorts — default = origin_year_asc (nulls last), plus origin_year_desc, updated_desc, name_asc, total_desc, system_size; deprecated last_used_asc/last_used_desc do NOT 500 (fall to default). (e) Backwards compat — legacy costume without new fields returns creator="", origin_year=null, additional_show_ids=[]. Frontend E2E verified: brand-logo src=/assets/logo.webp, dashboard-title="LUXE Inventory Management System", global-search-clear appears/disappears on typing/clear, Inventory filters/sort collapsed by default (toggle-filters-btn/toggle-sort-btn open filters-panel/sort-panel with filter-category/subcategory/location/flagged-btn — filter-size and filter-sizing-system correctly ABSENT), default sort chip = 'Origin year ↑ (oldest first)', search-clear works, view-list-btn shows row-thumb-{id} column with real images, Locations page tree UI supports add/rename/delete at 4 depths (root->A->1->x), Settings has settings-new-root-loc/add-root-loc-btn + LocationTree, Shows section with settings-new-show-name/year/add-show-btn plus show-row-{id}/edit-show-{id}/delete-show-{id}. CostumeFormDialog: form-location-level-0, form-creator, form-original-show, form-sub-location present; form-last-year is REMOVED; form-add-show-* toggle buttons render. Costume detail (/costume/:id) renders detail-name/detail-creator/detail-origin-year/detail-shows (original + additional)/detail-keywords for iter-4 costume; legacy costume correctly conditional-renders only detail-name.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan.
server.py uses synchronous `requests` inside async handlers (put_object/get_object) — will block the event loop under load; switch to httpx.AsyncClient or run in a threadpool.

list_costumes: default and origin_year_asc paths do a Python-side re-sort after Mongo sort to push nulls last — O(n) but acceptable for <2000 docs. For scale, use $sort with a computed field ($ifNull) in aggregation.
list_categories still synthesizes ghost categories from costume.category values with a fresh uuid on every call — the client will see a new id per request for ad-hoc categories.

CostumeUpdate uses model_dump(exclude_none=True) — clients cannot explicitly clear original_show_id / creator back to null via PUT (passing null is silently dropped). Consider exclude_unset=True + explicit nullable handling for original_show_id/creator/additional_show_ids.

Locations delete blocks when a node has children but does not check if any costume.location references its path — deleting a leaf still used by costumes leaves stale `costume.location` strings pointing at nothing. Consider blocking or cascading.

Show model_dump on PUT overwrites name/year but doesn't touch created_at, and origin_year propagation writes updated_at on all affected costumes — acceptable, but there's no transaction guarantee if the propagation fails partway.
Frontend route is /costume/:id (singular) while API/collection is /costumes — mild inconsistency, not a bug.
